tokens.name: brand-red
tokens.usage: Brand Red, set to #B22222 at the team's direction. Brand Guidelines V1 lists #DC172A instead (its own RGB 220/31/45 is #DC1F2D), so printed or official pieces may need the guide's value: confirm before print. Fills for primary buttons, small rules and one accent block. White text (`on-accent`) on it is 6.7:1. Never as text on `brand-black` or `brand-charcoal`: use `accent`.

tokens.name: brand-red-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for `brand-red` buttons (about 8% darker). White `on-accent` text on it is 7.5:1.

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Brand Black (#000000). Primary lockup ink, hero and band grounds in print. On dark surfaces it is a fill only.

tokens.name: brand-charcoal
tokens.usage: Brand Charcoal Grey (#363636). Secondary fill: bands, cards on black, cover blocks, and refined dark borders on light surfaces. White text on it is 12.1:1.

tokens.name: logo-plate
tokens.usage: White logo plate used in the light-theme header on `surface`. On dark surfaces (dark-theme headers and dark footer bands in both themes), render `.kp-plate` transparent with the crest intact (`0-22%`) and the wordmark masked in `on-band` (`22-100%`) instead of placing a harsh white box on dark backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `accent` all read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, diagram canvases, and table headers on `surface`. `ink`, `ink-muted`, `accent`, and all 6 campus tokens read on it.

tokens.name: surface-band
tokens.usage: Full-width bands and footers (black in light, charcoal in dark). Text on it: `on-band` and `on-band-muted`. Do not use for floating diagram/root cards on light canvases; use `node-root-*` tokens instead.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Extension of the brand palette: Brand Black in light, white in dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, mottos in small type on `surface` and `surface-raised`. 6.5:1 or better in light, 8.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Red when it is TEXT, a link, an ancestry highlight, or an icon on `surface` or `surface-raised`. Light = Brand Red (6.46:1 on white). Dark is bold crimson #F04E4E (5.57:1 on #0B0B0B, 4.93:1 on #1A1A1A).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand-red` fills (6.7:1).

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Headings, body copy, and masked wordmark lockups on dark bands (`surface-band` and dark-mode chrome).

tokens.name: on-band-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface-band`.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card edges only. Too faint to mark a control: use `border-strong` for controls.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outline buttons, and default diagram cards on `surface` and `surface-raised` (3:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring with a 2px offset. 3:1 or better on `surface`, `surface-raised` and on `brand-red` fills.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Neutral 75% black under white caption text on a photo or behind modal dialogs: the only gradient allowed (transparent to `scrim`). Never colored.

tokens.name: image-outline
tokens.usage: 1px inset outline on every photo so pale images keep an edge (`outline:1px solid; outline-offset:-1px`).

tokens.name: school-0
tokens.usage: Alpha Chapter — Northern Illinois University (Huskie Cardinal Red). Meets >= 3.0:1 UI contrast on `surface`, `surface-raised`, and `node-root-bg` in both themes.

tokens.name: school-1
tokens.usage: Beta Chapter — University of Illinois Chicago (Flames Blue). Meets >= 3.0:1 UI contrast on `surface`, `surface-raised`, and `node-root-bg` in both themes.

tokens.name: school-2
tokens.usage: University of Missouri — Mizzou (Tiger Gold; darkened in light mode for >= 3.0:1 UI contrast on raised surfaces, exact official #F1B82D in dark mode).

tokens.name: school-3
tokens.usage: Gamma Chapter — University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (Illini Orange). Meets >= 3.0:1 UI contrast on `surface`, `surface-raised`, and `node-root-bg` in both themes.

tokens.name: school-4
tokens.usage: Delta Chapter — Purdue University (Aged Gold in light mode, Campus Gold in dark mode). Meets >= 3.0:1 UI contrast on `surface`, `surface-raised`, and `node-root-bg`.

tokens.name: school-5
tokens.usage: Northwestern University Colony (official Northwestern Purple in light mode, lifted lavender-purple in dark mode). Meets >= 3.0:1 UI contrast on all node surfaces.

tokens.name: school-6
tokens.usage: University of Arkansas (official Razorback Cardinal in light mode, rose-crimson in dark mode). Meets >= 4.5:1 UI contrast on regular, raised, and root node surfaces.

tokens.name: node-root-bg
tokens.usage: Fill for anchor/root diagram cards. Stays a clean elevated light surface in light mode (never a harsh solid-black brick) and a soft charcoal elevation in dark mode.

tokens.name: node-root-border
tokens.usage: 2px border for root diagram cards and 2.5px border for selected diagram cards. Softer than pure black while maintaining > 10:1 contrast against `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: node-root-ink
tokens.usage: Primary line-name text inside root diagram cards (>= 14:1 contrast on `node-root-bg` in both themes).

tokens.name: node-root-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary metadata inside root diagram cards (>= 7.3:1 contrast on `node-root-bg` in both themes).

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Page hero, one per page. Set in caps for lockup-style titles.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Figures in a stat band. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy. Also the minimum font size on form inputs and selects to prevent iOS Safari focus auto-zoom.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Opening paragraph under a hero or page title. 60 characters wide at most.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, badges, eyebrows. Always uppercase. 12px is the typography floor.

styles.name: motto
styles.usage: The motto line under a wordmark. Always uppercase.

type.note: League Spartan from Google Fonts, Arial as fallback. No font file ships with the system. Headings and labels are uppercase by brand; body copy is sentence case.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, default gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards, desktop page gutters.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom on desktop. Sections on a page are 96px apart (64px on a phone).

spacing.note: 4px base. Every margin, padding and gap is a multiple of 4. Tight inside a group (space-2 to space-4), looser between groups (space-6 and up).

radius.note: Soft corners, set at the team's request. Earlier versions of this system were square; the crest, the lockup, bands and stripes stay square.

tokens.name: radius-sharp
tokens.usage: Full-width bands, header, footer, stripes, the logo plate and cover blocks. Anything that touches the page edge or echoes the crest's shield.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, icon tiles, date tiles, popovers, notices (right side only).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, diagram nodes, photos, photo grid tiles, tables, pillars. Inner media is square inside an `overflow:hidden` card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars, switches, campus dots, and truncation count pills only. Primary/secondary buttons are not pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Subtle elevation for raised cards when borders alone are insufficient.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, live-search comboboxes, and popovers.

tokens.name: node-root-shadow
tokens.usage: SVG drop-shadow elevation for anchor/root diagram cards so light-mode root nodes stand out gently without inverting to black.

duration.note: Motion answers an action and shows what changed. Hover and focus color changes, open and close. No ambient motion, no load animation by default.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Press and toggle feedback.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, border and color changes. The default.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Menus opening, panels sliding. Longest allowed.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every transition. Transition named properties (color, border-color, background-color), never `all`. Honor `prefers-reduced-motion`: no transition.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything pressable on a touch screen. Footer and menu links pad to it.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons (primary, secondary), inputs and selects.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header, with the logo lockup 44px high on desktop (36px compact / 30px <=400px).

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width for reading bands; app chrome and header bar align flush to the viewport edges.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Horizontal page gutter (20px on phone, 32px at >=700px).

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icon beside text, in table cells and icon rows.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icon in a 48px tile.

tokens.name: stripe-bar
tokens.usage: Stripe bar and gap; the stripe block is 88px wide by 24px tall.
